summary: This study is testing the drug Tirzepatide, also known as Spartina, in people who are obese after receiving a kidney transplant. The trial is currently Recruiting and plans to enroll 30 participants. It is a Phase 4 study sponsored by Shahid Beheshti University of Medical Sciences. Researchers will look at changes in body weight, stomach and gut comfort, and how well the transplanted kidney is working.

facts.sponsor: Shahid Beheshti University of Medical Sciences
